blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte resumed Thursday afternoon with the testimony of an official from the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), following the arrival of prosecution counsel Erwin Matibag, who was absent from the morning proceedings due to an illness.
